description: Printful shipment identifiers mirrored onto the Swell shipment. Written by the app under $app.printful.

shipment_id.description: Id of the Printful shipment this Swell shipment was created from. Printful splits an order across shipments, so this is what ties one Swell shipment back to one Printful shipment

tracking_url.description: Tracking link as Printful reported it. Kept rather than rebuilt from the tracking code, because the carrier is Printful's choice and its URL format is not ours to guess
